summary: Answer is a self-hosted knowledge base and question-and-answer platform designed for community support and user communication. It provides a structured forum interface where users can ask questions, share technical solutions, and organise information collaboratively.
goodFor: It suits teams and organisations wanting to host their own technical support forum or internal knowledge repository under an Apache-2.0 licence.
watchOut: Adopting a niche forum platform over established alternatives may limit your access to pre-built integrations, plugins, and community documentation.
deployNotes: Deployment typically relies on Docker, meaning you will need to configure persistent volumes for data storage and place the container behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
